entries.note: Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package must be confirmed to continue processing."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been created in the system."

Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The customs declaration has been submitted, and the package is being prepared for dispatch to the destination country." The first scan of parcels with no warehouse scan abroad.

Listed with this title in the status list of starexglobal.com; not seen in a parcel history. Asks the customer to pay the delivery fee and says nothing of where the parcel is, so the map leaves it out.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been received at the origin warehouse and is being prepared for dispatch."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is undergoing export customs clearance", in the country it leaves.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is on its way from the origin country to the destination country."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has arrived in the destination country and is being prepared for customs clearance."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is undergoing customs clearance."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been referred for additional customs inspection."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "No customs declaration has been submitted for the package." The customer declares it to customs.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is currently under customs review", after the declaration.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "Parcel will be delivered only after declaration is completed"; the page marks it red.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has successfully cleared customs."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is being sorted at the central warehouse."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is on its way to the pickup point", also before a courier delivery.
Listed with this title in the status list of starexglobal.com; not seen in a parcel history.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been handed over to the courier"
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been picked up by the courier"
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is on its way to the delivery address." Can repeat over several days before the delivery.
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package is ready for pickup at the branch."
Seen live on starexglobal.com's tracking lookup in English. "The package has been successfully delivered", at the branch or by the courier.
Listed with this title in the status list of starexglobal.com; not seen in a parcel history.
Listed with this title in the status list of starexglobal.com; not seen in a parcel history. It says the delivery is late, not where the parcel is, so the map leaves it out.
The order details reached Starex. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
Starex waits for the parcel to reach its warehouse abroad. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.

At the warehouse abroad, waiting to be consolidated with other parcels. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
Being prepared for dispatch at the warehouse abroad; in_foreign_bag shows the same text. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
Waiting to be sent on to Azerbaijan (the text spells Azərbayacan this way). Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
Left the warehouse abroad; foreign_customs_processing shows the same text. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
In flight to Azerbaijan. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.

At the pickup point. Listed in the status labels of Starex's own tracking page, seen in a 2024 capture of starex.az/baglama/.
